rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass in all four views, but it resolves as a tapered, faceted slab rather than a legible long-span gym hall. The dominant gesture is clear, yet the hierarchy is weakly aligned to the program because the form behaves like a compressed wedge with planar cuts instead of a hall body with subordinate service/support and a recognizable span or daylight roof section. There is almost no meaningful public void, court, or undercut at the access edge, so the verified frontage is effectively sealed rather than responded to. The silhouette is continuous and not stair-like, but the section logic does not convincingly communicate gymnasium program invariants. It has some resonance with elongated sports buildings in the references, but the more relevant precedents show a stronger long datum, public threshold, and usable void condition.
